guide.safety_reason: Loading and starting a washing machine is a routine household task.

steps.instruction: Pull open the soap drawer on the washer.
steps.title: Open soap drawer

steps.instruction: Pour soap from the green bottle into the drawer.
steps.title: Add green soap

steps.instruction: Push the soap drawer closed on the washer.
steps.title: Close soap drawer

steps.instruction: Pull open the soap drawer on the washer again.
steps.title: Open drawer again

steps.instruction: Pour liquid from the blue bottle into the drawer.
steps.title: Add blue liquid

steps.instruction: Push the soap drawer closed on the washer.
steps.title: Close drawer again

steps.instruction: Turn the round dial on the washer to choose.
steps.title: Turn wash dial

steps.instruction: Press the buttons on the washer display panel.
steps.title: Press wash buttons

steps.instruction: Put clothes from the basket into the washer.
steps.title: Load the clothes

steps.instruction: Push the round washer door shut.
steps.title: Close washer door

guide.title: Wash Clothes in Front Washer
